purpose.content: The interface lets the external controller read the newest valid Aster sample without exposing internal buffer mutation or probe control.

fields.boundary: The boundary exposes read-only access to buffered readings and hides validation, storage, and sampling implementation.
fields.participants: The external controller is the caller; the Aster export adapter is the provider.

contract.content: getLatestReading(sensorId) returns a Reading for a known sensor or NOT_READY when no valid sample exists; unknown identifiers fail explicitly.

fields.operations: getLatestReading(sensorId) is synchronous, read-only, and returns Reading, NOT_READY, or UNKNOWN_SENSOR.
fields.data_shapes: Reading contains sensorId, utcTimestamp, Celsius value, and quality; no internal buffer index or mutable reference is returned.

errors.content: An empty history is NOT_READY rather than an error, while an unknown sensor is UNKNOWN_SENSOR; every response leaves buffered history unchanged.

fields.error_behavior: Return UNKNOWN_SENSOR for unrecognized identifiers and NOT_READY for an empty buffer; transport failures are outside this contract.
fields.invariants: The operation never creates, modifies, reorders, or deletes a reading and never invents a timestamp or value.

compatibility.content: Version 1 clients require the original three reading fields; version 2 adds optional quality without changing operation name or error meanings.

fields.version_policy: Increment the major version only for removed fields, changed meanings, or new error behavior; optional additions remain minor changes.
fields.compatibility_policy: Version 1 readers may ignore quality, while version 2 readers must handle its absence for older exporters.

trace.content: The contract traces to Example::Controller and planned unknown-sensor, empty-history, valid-reading, and optional-quality compatibility checks.

fields.model_elements: Example::Controller is the external participant in the fictional read operation.
fields.verification_links: Planned interface cases cover NOT_READY, UNKNOWN_SENSOR, immutable history, and version 1/2 field handling.
